<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] [[jihadist]]s storm a village near [[Gamboru]], [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], killing three people and [[kidnapping]] more than 40 others. It is the second mass abduction by the [[Islamist]] group this month. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/27/at-least-40-loggers-feared-abducted-in-northeast-nigeria (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Spillover of the Syrian Civil War in Lebanon]]
**Hundreds of [[Syrians in Lebanon|Syrian]] [[Refugees of the Syrian Civil War|refugees]] flee a makeshift [[refugee camp|camp]] in [[North Governorate]], [[Lebanon]], after local youths storm the camp and torch tents, wounding three people, according to the [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-lebanon-refugees-syrians-camp/hundreds-of-syrians-flee-lebanon-camp-as-tents-torched-idUKKBN2910H0?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Darfur]]
**[[Sudan]] says it will deploy [[Sudanese Armed Forces|troops]] to [[South Darfur]] "in large numbers" following recent tribal violence between the [[Masalit people|Masalit]] and [[Fula people|Fula]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-sudan-security/sudan-deploys-troops-in-south-darfur-after-tribal-violence-report-idUKKBN2910PY?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs the [[Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021]], which contains a [[United States dollar|$]]900 billion [[COVID-19]] relief package, before Monday's deadline, in order to avert a [[Government shutdowns in the United States|government shutdown]]. This comes after Trump called the bill a "disgrace" last week. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/us-policy/2020/12/27/trump-stimulus-shutdown-congress/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/12/27/congress-stimulus-deal-450380 (Politico)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*In [[Cameroon]], a bus travelling from [[Douala]], to the [[capital city|capital]] [[Yaoundé]] collides with a truck and [[bus plunge|plunges]] into a [[ravine]], killing at least 37 people and injuring 19 others. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/cameroon-bus-accident-kills-at-least-37/articleshow/79979068.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[British Columbia]] reports their first case of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from a man in [[Island Health]] who returned from the [[United Kingdom]] on December 15 and tested positive on December 19. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/b-c-person-infected-covid-19-variant-1.5855654 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports 6,783 cases and 110 deaths between 24 and 26 December, bringing the total number of cases to 192,655 and deaths to 8,023. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2020/12/27/quebec-reports-6783-new-covid-19-cases-110-additional-deaths-since-december-24.html (''Toronto Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The U.S. surpasses 19 million cases of [[COVID-19]], having averaged 185,000 daily cases over the past week. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/public-global-health/531760-us-coronavirus-cases-pass-19-million (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oman]]
****[[Oman]] officially begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19 using the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] vaccine. The country is the last [[Gulf Cooperation Council]] member state to begin vaccinations. Health Minister Ahmed Al-Saidi is one of the first citizens to receive a dose of the vaccine. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1783571/amp (''Arab News'')]
****The Supreme Committee decides to reopen Oman's land, sea, and air borders on December 29 after closing them on December 21 due to fears of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. All travellers must show a negative [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR]] [[COVID-19 testing|test]] within 72 hours before entering the [[Oman|country]] and must have valid health insurance. In addition, all travellers must quarantine for seven days and take another test after completing their quarantine. [https://m.hindustantimes.com/world-news/oman-to-reopen-airport-borders-on-tuesday-after-mutation-scare/story-wFvcxdPHWi0RjD3TzdU1QN_amp.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 6,983 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 583,676. [https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2020/12/27/16151101/update-27-desember-pecah-rekor-6983-pasien-covid-19-sembuh-dalam-sehari (''Kompas'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Jordan]] reports their first two cases of a new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a couple who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2020-12-jordan-coronavirus-variant-cases-minister.html (Medical Xpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] announces that they will lift their flight ban on non-[[Saudis]] leaving the country. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/12/27/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-Saudi-Arabia-lifts-flight-ban-for-non-Saudis-leaving-the-kingdom (Al Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] extends its current [[social distancing]] measures aimed at reducing the spread of COVID-19 until January 3, as record numbers of new cases are being reported. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-extends-social-distancing-rules-amid-rising-daily-covid-19-cases (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] begins administering the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine tozinameran to its citizens. An 84-year-old woman becomes the first Austrian to be vaccinated against COVID-19 at the [[Medical University of Vienna]]. [https://orf.at/stories/3195150/ (ORF)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19 using the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] vaccine [[tozinameran]], with [[Prime Minister of the Czech Republic|Prime Minister]] [[Andrej Babiš]] and [[World War II]] veteran Emilie Řepíková among the first people to get vaccinated. [https://www.expats.cz/czech-news/article/czech-covid-19-vaccinations-begin-with-prime-minister-andrej-babis (Expats.cz)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] officially begins a [[vaccination]] programme against COVID-19, with [[Intensive care unit|ICU]] nurse Efstathia Kambissiouli, [[President of Greece|President]] [[Katerina Sakellaropoulou]] and [[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] among the first people to get vaccinated. [https://www.thenationalherald.com/archive_general_news_greece/arthro/covid_19_vaccinations_begin_in_greece_greek_president_pm_vaccinated-1476393/ (''The National Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Norway]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Norway]] reports its first cases of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2, after two people who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]] earlier in December test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-sweden-variant-idUSKBN2910KR (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Portugal]] reports their first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the [[United Kingdom]] in [[Madeira]]. [https://www.publico.pt/2020/12/27/sociedade/noticia/covid19-detectados-casos-nova-variante-madeira-1944298 (PUBLICO)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine [[tozinameran]]. The first person vaccinated is a 26-year-old doctor from [[Bucharest]]. [https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/sanatate/cea-mai-asteptata-zi-de-la-izbucnirea-pandemiei-incepe-vaccinarea-anti-covid-in-romania-1424357 (Digi24)]
***The [[European Union]] begins a mass vaccination campaign against COVID-19. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/vaccination-begins-450-million-europe-fears-grow-about-new-coronavirus-n1252384 (NBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Brazil]]ian [[Vice President of Brazil|Vice President]] [[Hamilton Mourão]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://diariodonordeste.verdesmares.com.br/politica/hamilton-mourao-testa-positivo-para-covid-19-e-fica-em-isolamento-em-brasilia-1.3026951 (''Diário do Nordeste'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay]]
****[[Uruguay]] reported a record of 11 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 158. [https://www.elpais.com.uy/informacion/salud/coronavirus-uruguay-registraron-casos-nuevos-muertes.html (''El País'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[South Africa]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19, becoming the first African country to reach this milestone. [https://www.voanews.com/covid-19-pandemic/south-africa-confirms-topping-1-million-covid-cases (Voice of America)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Kaiyuan stabbing attack]]
**Seven people are killed and seven others injured in a [[mass stabbing]] in [[Kaiyuan, Liaoning|Kaiyuan]], [[Liaoning]], [[China]]. The attacker has been arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-55460642 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 Nashville bombing]]
**Authorities officially identify the perpetrator of Friday's [[suicide bombing]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]], as 63-year-old Anthony Quinn Warner and conclude that he had been acting alone. [https://www.tennessean.com/story/news/crime/2020/12/27/nashville-explosion-questions-remain-investigation-enters-day-3/4050488001/ (''The Tennessean'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Nigerien general election]]
**Citizens in [[Niger]] head to the polls to elect their President in their first democratic power transfer since the country's independence from [[France]]. The election comes amidst a growing [[Islamist]] [[insurgency]] as [[Mohamed Bazoum]] is the favourite to succeed incumbent [[Mahamadou Issoufou]], who is stepping down after serving two five-year terms. [https://www.dw.com/en/niger-stages-historic-election-despite-jihadist-attacks/a-56066362 (DW)]
*[[2020 Central African general election]]
**Elections in the [[Central African Republic]] are underway, after a campaign marred by violence between [[government of the Central African Republic|government]] and rebel forces. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55458427 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[Solar Orbiter]] [[spacecraft]] makes its closest approach to [[Venus]]. [https://www.space.com/solar-orbiter-makes-first-venus-flyby (Space.com)]
